name_input: M/S NAV BHARAT TRADING CORPORATION; Nav Bharat Trading Corporation
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/nav-bharat-trading-corporation) reports 'Total Shipments 14 Records detected', 'Latest Cargo 2024-08-16', and every visible row is an INBOUND movement into India, e.g. '2024-08-16 | NAV BHARAT TRADING CORPORATION | APEX GULF TRADING LLC | LUBRICANT OIL MOBIL SHC GEAR 220 ,SIZE : 20 LTR | JNPT NHAVA SHEVA SEA, India | JEBEL ALI, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | 34039900 | BOL 3244223' and '2024-02-06 | NAV BHARAT TRADING CORPORATION | JINDAL LUBE TECH PRIVATE LIMITED | LUBRICATING OIL 27 | RAXAUL, India | BIRGUNJ, NEPAL | 27101990 | BOL 7301464'. Counter check: page header claims 14 records; only 5 rows were rendered in the free view (ports table sums to 8 of 14). No outbound/export row with India as origin was seen.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. The only public trace is the customs address '102, FIRST FOOR PLOT NO-3, DESH BANDHU GUPTA ROAD PAHAR GANJ, NEW DELHI, DELHI' on the ImportKey page. DuckDuckGo search returned no results (searx connection refused) and Volza returned HTTP 403, so domestic supply could not be tested.
note: Direction of trade is the key finding: all 5 visible customs rows (of 14 claimed) are IMPORTS into India — lubricants/greases (HS 34039900, 27101990) from UAE, Kyrgyzstan and Nepal — not exports. The declared HS codes 320810 / 320910 (paints and varnishes) and 732490 (sanitary ware) do not appear in any observed record; the actual traded HS codes are 34039900 and 27101990. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual codes, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. No export shipments found; no domestic supply evidence found — 'следов поставок не найдено' for the domestic market. Revenue and export volume: null (not public). Note the name 'Nav Bharat Trading Corporation' also appears as a buyer counterparty of 'NBTC GLOBAL DISTRIBUTORS INC.' in the Kyrgyzstan lane, which may indicate a related distribution structure — unverified. Search tooling was unavailable (searx refused connections, Volza 403), so this is a single-source result and should be re-checked when search is restored.
